name: Slow Cooker Boneless Beef Short Ribs
note: In-band (581 cal / 8g carbs), bare 5-ingredient slow-cooker beef braise: short ribs + fire-roasted diced tomatoes + garlic/onion/thyme, no starch base, weigh-and-divide to 14. Cross-lane check clean: this is the run's FIRST slow-cooker braise among accepted beef (all others are skillets/steaks: flank-parm, ground-beef-stroganoff, philly-stuffed-peppers, keto-cheeseburger, steak-bites-zucchini, stuffed-flank-rolls, steak-fajita), so it widens beef format diversity. No tomato-braised pork/chicken twin in the accepted list, so the adjudicator's cross-protein tomato-braise watch is not a present collision. Distinct from the run's other slow-cooker beef braise candidate (red-wine beef-cheeks, French, already terminally rejected-dupe of catalog beef-bourguignon) on flavor family (American tomato vs red-wine). Beef lane runs slightly heavy but 92 slots remain, so no need to trim a genuinely distinct plate. Short ribs unmapped (board tracks chuck-roast) - wanted for pricer-lane exercise per run brief, not a penalty.
